details: White (born 1979) is a Scottish-American computer scientist and technical leader at Microsoft in Redmond, WA, USA.. He is a Distinguished Scientist and a Vice President of Applied Science, currently leading the science organization for OneDrive and SharePoint. Ryen is known for his contributions to information retrieval, human-computer interaction, and computational health.
story: Imagine a driving test that every new model has to pass before it is allowed on the road. It is the exam that separates “it sounds good” from “it actually is good”. A fair scoreboard keeps everyone honest. It is the exam that keeps everyone honest. And that, done honestly, is Ryen W. White.
